risks.risk: Battery condition is unknown (could be dead/condemned or could still have usable capacity). This heavily affects what you should pay.
risks.proof: A close-up video/photo of each battery’s terminal voltage (or a load test) plus a simple working/dead indicator (e.g., inverter run test or battery tester reading).
risks.if_unproven: Price as fully dead/condemned (worst case for value).

risks.risk: Quantity/units are unclear (how many batteries/cells are included in the crate stack).
risks.proof: A clear count: photo showing the number of battery units per crate and total crates, or a labeled inventory sheet.
risks.if_unproven: Price as the smallest plausible quantity shown (worst case for you).

risks.risk: Battery type/spec is unclear (e.g., 12V vs 6V, capacity/Ah, lead-acid vs other).
risks.proof: Close-up of any label/sticker on the battery crate or cell showing voltage and Ah rating.
risks.if_unproven: Price as generic lead-acid inverter batteries with unknown/lowest value spec.

risks.risk: Potential mismatch: what’s shown may be battery packs/cells in crates rather than complete inverter batteries, affecting resale/recycling value.
risks.proof: Photos of one unit removed from the crate showing whether it’s a complete battery (with casing/terminals) or loose cells/modules.
risks.if_unproven: Price as loose/condemned modules (lower value than complete batteries).

risks.risk: Pickup/handling terms could have hidden conditions (distance limits, minimum quantity, or deductions).
risks.proof: Written pickup terms: location coverage, minimum load, and any deductions/fees.
risks.if_unproven: Assume pickup may not be fully free or may require minimum quantity; price accordingly.

proof_requests: Send a clear close-up of any readable label/sticker showing battery voltage (e.g., 12V/6V) and Ah rating.
Provide terminal voltage readings (or battery tester/load test results) for a representative sample and ideally all units.
Show a clear count of total batteries/units (how many complete batteries vs cells/modules).
Confirm pickup terms in writing (pickup location range, minimum quantity, and whether any fees/deductions apply).
